s1.desc: a kitchen with a white wall cupboard above a curved teal counter, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with the cupboard standing open and crammed with plastic food containers, and a round window

beats.text: Pax stands at the open cupboard hugging a tall stack of plastic food containers, swaying a little as he looks up at the crowded shelves
Pax swings the stack over to one side and blinks, still hugging it to his chest
Pax shifts the stack back in front of him and stares up at the full cupboard

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the window/door band (y 0.15-0.40, x 0.45-1.0) scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 every 5th frame f5-50; whole-frame diff exactly 0 on still frames f1-5, f15-21, f31-36, f47-50. Eyes shut f25-26 (blink). Containers are plain (no prints); no caption or watermark. Hard cut at f51
19 frames: insert of the crammed cupboard shelves, Pax's flippers shove more containers in and swing the door shut (only flippers visible, also lead_hidden)

spans.view: with a round window beside the cupboard

beats.text: Pax stands below the cupboard as its door swings shut, one flipper raised up toward it while he looks up at it
Pax shifts his weight a little to the right, still holding his flipper up toward the cupboard
Pax lowers his flipper and shuts his eyes with a pleased little smile
Pax turns to face forward and waddles off to the left, out of the picture

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the window band (y 0.10-0.42, x 0.55-1.0) scale 1.0001, 0 px, cc 1.000 f78-142; counter-left band (y 0.60-0.75, x 0-0.30) identity until Pax walks through it; diff of f72 vs f100 is Pax only. The door is still swinging shut on f70-71. Eyes shut f117-122. Pax's body height stays ~750 px while he walks left (feet 1555 -> 1597 px), so size_change false. He is mostly gone by f150, last sliver f152; f153-157 empty
5 frames of the empty kitchen after Pax leaves (also no_lead)
7 frames: hard cut to the same kitchen at night (dim, crescent moon in the window), empty until Polly's flipper tip edges in at the right from f163 (also no_lead)

spans.view: with a round window showing a crescent moon

beats.text: Polly walks in from the right and stops in front of the counter below the wall cupboard
Polly stands under the cupboard and reaches one flipper up toward its closed door
Polly smiles with her eyes shut, then turns her back and swings the cupboard door open
Polly stands with her back turned, facing the overstuffed open cupboard with one flipper held out to the side

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the cupboard band (y 0.15-0.42, x 0-0.30) scale 0.9999, 0 px, cc 1.000 f164-212, and on the window band identity except while Polly crosses it; window-region diff vs f158 constant 0.08 from f168 (a star twinkle). Night grade: a mild neutral dim (whites at 225/255, hues kept, Polly's colours still read), kept as time night like Eepy [134,160), not the tinted lights-off wash that was dropped as effect in Unhelpful. f213->f214 is a two-frame pose snap (Polly turns her back as the door flies open), same background, not a cut. The containers start to burst out on f235

the containers burst out as a teal splash shape that sweeps across the picture and buries Polly (f235-243), wiping to a new framing that slides in from the right and settles at f253 (pile region diff falls 18 -> 0 over f244-253)
17 locked frames: Pax stands beside a heap of spilled containers, a flipper poking out of the heap (Polly buried, lead_hidden), and puts a flipper to his chin. Skit ends
